eyebrow: What a lone view can't do
code:
ONE MORE SQL SERVER VIEW:
  No version history -- changes are invisible
  No automated test -- a bad edit ships silently
  No structural reason 3 teams discover/reuse it
  == the exact pattern that caused this problem

SNOWFLAKE + dbt + GIT:
  Every change reviewed via pull request
  dbt tests block a broken definition from merging
  One governed mart, discoverable by name, by all 3 teams
caption: Same logic, structurally impossible to fragment again.

code:
"We're keeping SQL Server exactly as it is -- it's not broken,
it's ungoverned downstream of it. We're adding a nightly
extraction into Snowflake and a tested, version-controlled dbt
project on top of it, so the active-member definition lives in
exactly one place, and every team's Power BI report reads from
the same governed mart instead of writing its own query again."
caption: No downtime, no migration risk to billing or check-ins.
